description:
Exceptional 3 -BedroomHome | Approx. 127 sq. m. High-Spec Finish  Prime Cul-de-Sac Location

We are delighted to bring this outstanding 3 -bedroom family home to the market. Extending to approximately 127 sq. m., this beautifully presented property offers spacious, well-designed accommodation over two floors and has been finished to an exceptional standard throughout. With numerous recent upgrades, generous living space, and a superb location, this is an ideal home for growing families or those seeking modern, comfortable living.

The welcoming entrance hall leads into a bright and spacious living room featuring a beautiful fireplace, creating a warm and inviting space for relaxing or entertaining. Double doors lead through to the dining area, which flows seamlessly into the well-appointed kitchen. A separate utility/laundry room and a fully fitted ground-floor bathroom provide excellent practicality for everyday family life.

Upstairs, the property boasts four generously proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious primary bedroom with a newly refurbished, high-spec en-suite bathroom. A stylish family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms, ensuring ample space and convenience for the entire household.

The home has been exceptionally well maintained and benefits from a host of quality upgrades, including a new boiler, newly installed radiators, zoned heating, a water softener and filtration system, and attractive solid wood flooring throughout.

Outside, the property enjoys a fully enclosed, gated rear garden, offering a safe and private space for children and outdoor entertaining. To the front, there are two private parking spaces.

Situated in a quiet cul-de-sac within a highly sought-after residential development, this superb home enjoys an unbeatable location. Local shops, cafés, pubs, restaurants, schools, and everyday amenities are all within easy walking distance. Excellent public transport links, including regular bus services and the nearby train station (approximately a 10-minute walk), provide easy access to surrounding towns and cities.
